_about: Metadata for clips in source-videos/. Keys under 'clips' are short aliases for referring to a clip in code, notes, and the write-up. Raw .mp4 files are gitignored; this file is tracked.

_fields.role: main | validation | backup | dev | unused | excluded. validation = held-out clip similar to main (roles.validation may list several); tune parameters on main, then check they still work here without re-tuning. dev = clean-mask clip for developing/debugging an algorithm (BFS) before moving to main
_fields.source_url: Pexels page the file was downloaded from (Pexels page IDs can differ from the file-name ID)
_fields.width/height/fps/duration_s/codec/audio: measured with ffprobe on the actual file (not taken from the file name)
_fields.stability: camera motion vs. first frame, sampled every 2 s (ORB features + RANSAC similarity fit; the ucsd-i5-* clips used landmark template matching instead, see their notes); max_shift_px in full-res pixels. stable = a few px or less. Clips marked softwarestab were stabilized in DaVinci Resolve first; stability describes the stabilized file
_fields.annotations.count_line: line-crossing geometry, e.g. [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]] in full-res pixels; null until designed
_fields.annotations.mask_regions: polygons to ignore (overlays, trees); empty until needed
_fields.annotations.ground_truth: manual vehicle count for benchmarking; null until counted
_fields.author: Pexels creator (attribution optional under the license), or Julian for own footage; null if not recorded

source: Pexels (6 clips) plus Julian's own footage (i5-*, 16th-st*, ucsd-i5-*)

auckland-hwy.author: Kiwi and Camera
auckland-hwy.notes: Main clip until 2026-10-31 (all Week 2-5 tuning was done on it). Tripod, dense traffic, close/telephoto view: expect overlapping vehicles (merged blobs). Left lane is clipped near top of the video

auckland-fwy.author: Kiwi and Camera
auckland-fwy.notes: Validation clip until 2026-10-31. Same creator as auckland-hwy (also Auckland), but framed differently (not the same camera position), so it needs its own count_line.

urban-road.notes: Tripod, sparse traffic, little occlusion: easy case for checking BFS blobs. 4K60, so downscale before processing.

birdseye-4way.notes: Best geometry (top-down, little occlusion) but the drone slowly drifts and rotates, which shows up as false foreground. Filename says 3840x2160; actual file is 2560x1440.

motorway-vertical.notes: Portrait video, sparse traffic, mild drift. Borderline.

skyline-hwy.notes: Shot from a moving vehicle; background subtraction won't work.

i5-incoming.notes: Overpass view of I-5, software-stabilized in DaVinci Resolve (raw clip wandered 58.7 px; 60 fps version is unstabilized, skipped). 1095 frames. Sparse traffic (1-3 cars in view), clean MOG2 masks: used for BFS development. A car's shadow on the shoulder joins its blob. Worst outer 8 px band is 2.7% near-black (crop gap): keep the count line away from the edges. Fields not measured with ffprobe: source_url, codec, audio.

i5-outgoing.notes: Opposite direction of the same I-5 footage, software-stabilized but creeps from 2 px to 7.7 px (low inlier ratio, 4-14%). Black bars at top/bottom change size per frame (Zoom was off); re-export with Zoom ~5-10% if wanted. Denser side-by-side traffic: good stress case but MOG2 blobs are fragmented/hollow (12.9 blobs/frame). Raw clip wandered 107 px. Duration approximate (36-37 s). Fields not measured with ffprobe: source_url, codec, audio, rotation.

16th-st.author: Julian (own iPhone footage)
16th-st.scene: one-way city street, one moving lane between parked cars and a construction site
16th-st.notes: From 16th-st-city-college.MOV (HEVC 10-bit HLG/Dolby Vision, 1080p59.94, drifted ~50 px vertically). Tone-mapped to SDR with ffmpeg scale_vt, 30 fps, then locked to frame 0 with scratch/stabilize.py and cropped by (12, 35) px. Traffic flows top-right -> bottom-left, ~7 px/frame; most of it is in frames ~0-500, then the street is empty. Trees on the left sway (small blobs). count_line is perpendicular to the lane axis (35 deg) through its middle (708, 605).

16th-st-2.author: Julian (own iPhone footage)
16th-st-2.scene: one-way city street, one moving lane between parked cars and a construction site; cross street at top right
16th-st-2.notes: Same street as 16th-st, framed slightly differently. From 16th-st-city-college-2.MOV (HEVC 10-bit HLG, 1080p59.94, drifted -52..+9 px vertically). Tone-mapped to SDR with ffmpeg scale_vt, 30 fps, then locked to frame 0 with scratch/stabilize.py and cropped by (3, 54) px. Traffic flows top-right -> bottom-left; some vehicles turn in from the cross street at the top right. Traffic spread across the whole clip. Tall vehicles overlap the parked-car row (heatmap). count_line is perpendicular to the lane axis (38 deg) through (1037, 534), below where turning traffic joins.

ucsd-i5-incoming.author: Julian (own footage, shot 2026-10-30)
ucsd-i5-incoming.scene: highway (I-5 overpass near UCSD), 4 lanes plus shoulders toward the camera
ucsd-i5-incoming.notes: Main clip 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-01, then validation (replaced by the steadier DSLR take ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr). Phone footage. Stabilized and contrast-boosted in DaVinci Resolve, 3426 frames, 23 Mbps. Not measured with the ORB method: landmark template matching (2026-10-31) shows the lower left is steady (<= 11 px over the clip) but the top/right drifts slowly, ~30-40 px by the end (rotation/scale drift, not a shift). Slow enough that MOG2 at rate 0.003 absorbs it (fg pixels don't grow over the clip). A dark camera-attached occluder on the right edge (x > ~1750, y ~300-850) moves in the stabilized frame and makes small blobs there; the opposite carriageway (top right) has traffic going the other way, kept above y ~460. Warm-up (warmup_check @0.5): settles at frame 54 -> 69. Traffic is heavy for the first ~40 s, then thins out; ~76 vehicles cross the count line after frame 120 (tracker, unverified). count_line y = 550 sits between the far-road noise and the occluder noise and spans both shoulders; y = 550 and 650 both gave 76 on-road crossings and none off-road, while 450/750/950 picked up far-road, occluder or hillside crossings. 60 fps: tracker constants counted in frames (maxMissed, warmupFrames) cover half the time they do at 25-30 fps.

ucsd-i5-outgoing.author: Julian (own footage, shot 2026-10-30)
ucsd-i5-outgoing.scene: highway (I-5 overpass near UCSD, same spot as ucsd-i5-incoming), 5 lanes plus shoulder going away from the camera
ucsd-i5-outgoing.notes: Opposite direction of ucsd-i5-incoming, same session. Stabilized and contrast-boosted in DaVinci Resolve, 4878 frames, 11 Mbps. Landmark template matching (2026-10-31; not the ORB method): the whole frame creeps right by ~1 px per 100 frames, 12 px by frame 1200 and 17-21 px by the end; landmarks agree to within a few px, so it is mostly a shift. MOG2 at rate 0.003 absorbs it (fg pixels follow traffic, no growth). A large blurry dark occluder covers the right edge (x > ~1650) and makes small blobs at y ~40-680; the opposite carriageway (top left) has traffic down to y ~450 at the left edge. Traffic enters at the bottom and leaves at the top. Warm-up (warmup_check @0.5): settles at frame 50 -> 65. ~100 vehicles cross the count line after frame 120 (tracker, unverified). count_line y = 750 is below the occluder noise and the opposite traffic and spans the left shoulder to the right shoulder; 750 and 850 gave 100 on-road crossings and none off-road, 550/650 gave 98, 450 picked up 2 occluder crossings and 950 picked up 4 at the left edge.

ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr.author: Julian (own footage, DSLR, shot 2026-10-30)
ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr.scene: highway (I-5 overpass near UCSD), 4 lanes toward the camera
ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr.notes: Same I-5 overpass and direction as ucsd-i5-incoming, but shot on a DSLR instead of a phone the same day (2026-10-30), stabilized and contrast-boosted in DaVinci Resolve. Tighter framing: the 4 incoming lanes fill the frame, the opposite carriageway only shows in the top-right corner (y < ~200), no right-edge occluder. 2972 frames. Landmark template matching (2026-11-01): <= 2 px over the clip. Warm-up (warmup_check @0.5, area 100): settles at frame 1 -> 16. Some foreground specks on the left shoulder/hillside around y ~500-740. count_line y = 400 (tracker survey of y = 300-900: 71-76 crossings after frame 120 on every line, unverified); y = 600 and 700 each picked up one off-road crossing on the left shoulder, 400 and 800 none. y = 400 is below the opposite carriageway and above the shoulder noise, and gives tracks time to confirm (traffic enters at the top). 73 crossings at y = 400.

ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr2.author: Julian (own footage, DSLR, shot 2026-10-30)
ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr2.scene: highway (I-5 overpass near UCSD), 4 lanes toward the camera
ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr2.notes: Same I-5 overpass and direction as ucsd-i5-incoming, but shot on a DSLR instead of a phone the same day (2026-10-30), stabilized and contrast-boosted in DaVinci Resolve. Tighter framing: the 4 incoming lanes fill the frame, the opposite carriageway only shows in the top-right corner (y < ~200), no right-edge occluder. 2972 frames. Second DSLR take, different traffic. An out-of-focus fence in front of the lens casts a static blotchy dark pattern over the whole frame (static, so MOG2 learns it). Landmark template matching (2026-11-01): <= 6 px over the clip (slow creep, ~(-3, 4) px by the end). Warm-up (warmup_check @0.5, area 100): settles at frame 19 -> 34. count_line y = 400, same as ucsd-i5-incoming-dslr (tracker survey of y = 300-900: 63-67 crossings after frame 120, unverified; only y = 900 picked up an off-road crossing). 66 crossings at y = 400.
